Listening to 9to5Mac's curated daily headlines. 9to5Mac Daily is now available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, and Google Play, and can also be subscribed to via its dedicated RSS feed on Overcast and other podcast platforms.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you organize everything in your mind into a simple and elegant system—helping you put an end to the suspense of unfinished tasks and relieving psychological stress. A simple to-do app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, equipped with powerful tools that make organizing, tracking, and completing tasks more satisfying. Get everything done with Stuff now.

A brand new episode of 9to5Mac Daily is recorded every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast platform to make sure you can listen to every episode as soon as it's released.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • watchOS 27.2 beta 2 reintroduces app switcher with an all-new gesture
  • Report says Apple is developing a fitness tracker similar to Whoop, without a screen
  • What's going on with GM's CarPlay strategy (or lack thereof)?
  • Apple discontinues the unique augmented reality experience at the Apple Park Visitor Center
